description: Runtime wiring backlog for heuristic/advisory/sidecar surfaces that still affect production-readiness

completed.notes: P1 complete - diffusion requests now carry governed hypotheses plus routing context, the diffusion stub reranks governed hypotheses before any fallback lane, and Stage-1 datapack admission now degrades heuristic/unbenchmarked video manifests into explicit shadow-only work orders instead of pretending benchmark readiness.

P1 complete - replay ingest and bootstrap semantic workcell metadata now clamp passthrough/auto SceneTracks to explicit fallback semantics instead of marking them non-stub or non-heuristic; only real SceneTracks stay eligible for grounded/non-stub truth.

P1 complete - bootstrap workcell episodes now emit canonical per-episode runtime packet / event spine / decision ledger artifacts, replay import now discovers those refs directly, and bootstrap summaries now distinguish trace-complete rows from real-SAM3D grounded-data readiness.

P1 complete - the coverage harvester now canonicalizes workcell env/task/skill ids and the skill graph now includes a built-in peg_in_hole workcell chain, so workcell bootstrap rows land in the canonical coverage graph instead of collapsing to task-only evidence.

P1 complete - shadow advisory now auto-consumes semantic runtime scorer packages when present, threads bounded learned route/regret/counterfactual/authority signals into replay sampling, and preserves that evidence through live queue-selection metadata; the heuristic path remains only as an explicit fallback when no scorer package exists yet.

P1 complete - Stage 1 routing, local synthetic branch metadata, synthetic corpus benchmark gating, live semantic runtime scoring, and degraded-fusion artifacts now all share the same SceneTracks truth normalization, and the SceneTracks runner now emits explicit GPU + SAM3D host preconditions for real grounded-data readiness.

P1 complete - semantic policy selection now ranks datapacks using ARH-adjusted historical outcomes, candidate quality/novelty, benchmark/readiness support, and explicit gap-fill pressure; semantic simulation now records the resulting selection summary into live results and run logs.

P1 complete - shadow advisory now emits explicit semantic-runtime scorer precondition artifacts and blocking work orders when no scorer package is available, and the main advisory/training consumers persist those artifacts into runtime outputs instead of hiding the fallback inside branch logic.

P2 complete - DatapackConfig/registry now preserve metadata plus quality/novelty across YAML and ontology, rollout labeling aggregates teacher-runtime/SceneTracks/provenance/precondition truth into labeled datapacks, and semantic simulation enriches those datapacks with semantic-fusion artifact refs and readiness instead of dropping vision semantics as sidecars.

P2 complete - semantic runtime backbone now emits compact runtime-truth / benchmark / execution-precondition summaries, and observation/condition-vector builders now preserve and react to those signals so benchmark-unready grounding or blocked fusion changes conditioning instead of remaining metadata-only.

P1 complete - local synthetic branches now emit explicit gen2sim validity sidecars, corpus/trainer policy now reacts materially to admission truth, Regal datapack valuation now resolves the explicit assessment plus a bounded learned helper package, and the learned helper remains honestly benchmark-gated on empirical receipt density.

P1 complete - semantic selection now exports a real bounded neural helper package, persists per-episode selection_summary sidecars into rollout artifacts, replay ingest preserves those summaries into runtime rows, and orchestration context encoding now reacts to selection-policy/helper-status/meta-choice features instead of dropping them after the sim run log.

P1 complete - orchestration transformer/runtime now use bounded multi-step tool logits with an explicit PAD/stop label, runtime planning records model sequence traces before bounded heuristic backfill, and the trainer/eval path now optimizes and reports full bounded tool-sequence behavior instead of only the first routing decision.

P1 complete - meta-transformer runtime/training now carry a shared planning-context contract over semantic/econ/datapack/selector receipts, the trained helper now predicts bounded objective/backend/energy-profile/data-mix/expected-delta outputs, and runtime records both planning traces and the bounded planning_application receipt explaining why the final meta-choice stayed heuristic-prior or moved toward the learned helper.

P1 complete - removed the fake D4 learned stub, added a canonical knob-model trainer/runtime-package lane with runtime receipt ingestion, wired bounded benchmark-gated helper loading into the homeostatic planner, and preserved knob-policy regime/base-config receipts in GateStatus plus closed-loop smoke artifacts.

backlog.blocked_by: runtime shell outcome receipts and denser promoted orchestration/meta traces
backlog.notes: SemanticOrchestrator, SemanticOrchestratorV2, and PipelineManager still make mostly deterministic shell/stage/meta-choice decisions above the now-real selector, sequence, meta-transformer, and knob helper lanes.

backlog.blocked_by: queue outcome receipts and replay counterfactual labels
backlog.notes: Queue selection, replay weighting, and episode sampling still use a largely heuristic core even though they now ingest learned helper scores; this needs its own bounded learned policy layer.

backlog.blocked_by: GPU host with SAM3D checkpoints and real workcell refresh runs
backlog.notes: Grounded-data honesty is fixed, but benchmark-grade workcell/vision promotion still cannot happen until SceneTracks/SAM3D runs produce real grounded data rather than passthrough fallback outputs.
